messages.content:
<question>
My lease in Dubai expires on 2027-01-20 and I want to ask my landlord to lower the rent at renewal. Today is 2026-10-19. What is the last day I can send him my notice, and am I still in time?
</question>

<answer>
Unless the parties agreed otherwise, a party who wants to amend any term of a lease, including the rent, must notify the other party of that intent no less than ninety days before the lease expires [1]. Before expiry, the parties may amend any term of the lease or reconsider increasing or reducing the rent [2]. Ninety days before 2027-01-20 is 2026-10-22, so the notice must be given on or before 2026-10-22 [1]. On 2026-10-19, three days remain before that deadline [1]. If the parties cannot agree, the Tribunal may determine the fair rent, taking into account the criteria in article 9 [2].
</answer>

<reference>
Unless the parties agreed otherwise, a party who wants to amend any term of the lease, which includes reconsidering the rent, must notify the other party of that intent no less than ninety days before the lease expires (art. 14 of Law No. (26) of 2007 as restated by Law No. (33) of 2008; art. 13 lets the parties, before expiry, amend any term or reconsider increasing or reducing the rent). Ninety days before 2027-01-20 is 2026-10-22, so the notice must be given on or before 2026-10-22; on 2026-10-19 there are three days left. If the parties cannot agree, the Tribunal may determine the fair rent, taking into account the criteria in art. 9 (art. 13).
</reference>
